description: Reference ground truth for the annotated episodes at the Lidoire mill. Keyed by peak date (YYYY-MM-DD), not by the historical EP numbers, which are inconsistent across code and docstrings. Extracted from backend/validate_model.py, backend/analyze_episodes.py and the docstrings of backend/app/services/risk_v2.py.
caveats: Not exhaustive: every negative is a model detection (risk score or river threshold); floods the model missed were never labelled, so POD/miss rate cannot be computed from this set alone.
peak_time values are approximate (mostly 06:00 or 12:00, i.e. day-level precision) and naive; UTC is assumed, as in InfluxDB.
severity is a 1-5 field required for every episode: for floods it describes damage, for non-floods it is the estimated hazard level of the detection. Do not compare severities across outcomes.
outcome near_miss is an interpretation of the owner's notes ('bien monte', 'haut'); both scripts treated these as flood=False.
legacy_stored_score is the risk score stored at peak by an older model (validate_model.py 'old'), kept only for regression comparisons; it is not ground truth.
inconsistencies: EP14 is 2023-12-01 (25 cm inside) in validate_model.py / analyze_episodes.py and in the risk_v2 momentum comment (5 rising, river=0.602), but risk_v2 v3.2 docstring and conjunction comment call 'EP14 April 23' (Pessac 0.62, Abzac 0.93, Coutras 0.87) the 2025-04-23 flood, which is id=1 in the scripts and 'episode avril 2025 (id=1)' in the v2.2 docstring.

risk_v2 docstring says '5 confirmed floods, 9 false positives' but 2026-01-28 is noted 'en cours, pas encore inonde' (outcome not known when labelled) and two non-floods are near misses rather than false positives.
2024-02-26 water height: validate_model.py says '25cm eau', analyze_episodes.py says '20-25cm eau interieur moulin'.
2023-12-11 is described as a 'continuation' of December 2023, 10 days after the 2023-12-01 peak; it may be the same hydrological event counted twice.
2023-03-11 flood was caused by infiltration (since sealed): the mechanism no longer applies, it should probably be excluded or weighted down in evaluation.
CLAUDE.md and the detector default start at 2022-11-01 but the earliest labelled episode is 2023-01-18.
calculate_risk_score_v2 docstring says weights were 'calibrated from Feb 2024 episode' while the module docstring says v3.0 was calibrated on all 14 episodes.
Non-flood episodes carry severities up to 4 (2026-01-28) and 3 (2025-11-25), higher than the 2023-03-11 and 2023-12-11 floods (3).
